action.sql: WITH actual AS (SELECT g.dept_id, SUM(g.debit - g.credit) AS actual_amt FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND g.period = '2026-04' AND a.type = 'Expense' AND CAST(g.account_id AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 6000 AND 6999 GROUP BY g.dept_id), bud AS (SELECT dept_id, SUM(amount) AS budget_amt FROM budgets WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND period = '2026-04' AND CAST(account_id AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 6000 AND 6999 GROUP BY dept_id) SELECT COALESCE(a.dept_id, b.dept_id) AS dept_id FROM actual a FULL OUTER JOIN bud b ON a.dept_id = b.dept_id WHERE COALESCE(a.actual_amt, 0) > COALESCE(b.budget_amt, 0) ORDER BY dept_id
